tools.name: get_onboarding_status
tools.description: Get the live status of an agent-first onboarding workspace: workspace and claim state, the setup checklist (knowledge crawl/training, persona, starters, …), the browser onboarding page URL, and the POST-only claim API endpoint (claimUrl is for agents/CLI clients — never a page to open in a browser).

tools.name: get_chatbot_appearance
tools.description: Read the chatbot widget appearance (colors, launcher position and shape, title, welcome message, placeholder, tooltip) plus its starter questions, for the inline appearance card. Uses GET /api/v2/chatbots/{chatbotId}/settings/appearance and GET /api/v2/chatbots/{chatbotId}/starters.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List a chatbot conversation inbox with filters (open/resolved status, escalated-only) and cursor pagination, projected to compact rows with a last-message snippet. Renders as the inline conversations inbox. Uses GET /api/v2/chatbots/{chatbotId}/conversations.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Read one conversation with its transcript (visitor questions and chatbot/system answers, capped at 2000 characters per message). Renders as the transcript panel of the inline conversations inbox. Uses GET /api/v2/chatbots/{chatbotId}/conversations/{threadId}.

tools.name: list_leads
tools.description: List the leads a chatbot collected (name, email, phone, received time, starred/archived flags) with search, status filter, and cursor pagination. Renders as the inline leads browser. Uses GET /api/v2/chatbots/{chatbotId}/leads.

tools.name: list_escalations
tools.description: List the open conversations that are escalated to a human and waiting — the queue behind the inline escalations view — with cursor pagination for queues longer than one page. tools.name: list_knowledge_sources
tools.description: List a chatbot connector data sources (Notion, Google Drive, Confluence, …) with their sync state, plus document counts by ingestion status. Renders as the inline knowledge view. Uses GET /api/v2/chatbots/{chatbotId}/knowledge/sources and GET /api/v2/chatbots/{chatbotId}/documents/stats.

tools.name: create_knowledge_source
tools.description: Create a new OAuth knowledge source connection (Notion, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, SharePoint, or Confluence) and get the browser authorization URL to finish connecting it. tools.name: authorize_knowledge_source
tools.description: Get a fresh browser authorization URL for an existing knowledge source connection (for example one still pending OAuth). Uses POST /api/v2/chatbots/{chatbotId}/knowledge/sources/{connectionId}/authorize.

tools.name: upload_knowledge_file
tools.description: Upload one file (base64-encoded, max 1500000 bytes decoded — about 1.5 MB; the MCP transport caps request bodies, larger files go through the dashboard) as chatbot training knowledge. Ingestion is queued asynchronously. Uses POST /api/v2/chatbots/{chatbotId}/knowledge/files.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, execute_read, execute_write, preview_chatbot, send_chat_message, get_onboarding_status, get_chatbot_appearance, list_conversations, get_conversation, get_chatbot_analytics, list_leads, list_escalations, create_knowledge_source, authorize_knowledge_source · Private data: search, execute_read, execute_write, get_onboarding_status, list_knowledge_sources, create_knowledge_source, upload_knowledge_file · Public sink: search, execute_read, execute_write, send_chat_message, get_onboarding_status, list_leads, create_knowledge_source, authorize_knowledge_source, upload_knowledge_file · Destructive: search, execute_read, execute_write.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, execute_read, execute_write, preview_chatbot, send_chat_message, get_onboarding_status, get_chatbot_appearance, list_conversations, get_conversation, get_chatbot_analytics, list_leads, list_escalations, create_knowledge_source, authorize_knowledge_source · Private data: search, execute_read, execute_write, get_onboarding_status, list_knowledge_sources, create_knowledge_source, upload_knowledge_file · Public sink: search, execute_read, execute_write, send_chat_message, get_onboarding_status, list_leads, create_knowledge_source, authorize_knowledge_source, upload_knowledge_file · Destructive: search, execute_read, execute_write

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
